The '''ScorSear 200 survival kit'''<ref name="AORC">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> was a suit of [[Environment suit/Legends|adverse environment gear]] produced by the [[Pretormin Environmental/Legends|Pretormin Environmental]] company and sold for 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The gear was available following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ScorSear 200 was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]]. The full name of ScorSear 200 survival kit was given in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released by Fantasy Flight Games a [[2014|year later]].
